## Summary

I implemented customerCode de-duplication in `ClinicServiceImpl.generateCustomerCode()` (`src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/service/ClinicServiceImpl.java`).

The method already computed a base code of the form `<REGION>-<HASH8>`. I added a collision check: it now gathers all existing owners' non-null `customerCode` values and, if the computed base already exists, appends `-<n>` with the smallest `n` ≥ 2 that produces a unique code (e.g. `NSW-1A2B3C4D-2`, then `-3`, etc.). When there's no collision the base code is returned unchanged.

The lookup reuses the existing `ownerRepository.findAll().stream()` idiom already used by `countNamesakes` and `countOwnersInCity` in the same class, and all required imports (`Set`, `Objects`, `Collectors`) were already present.

Tests: `./mvnw -o test` → **BUILD SUCCESS**, `Tests run: 1, Failures: 0, Errors: 0` (the `AcceptanceTest.coreCustomerCodesStayUnique` case asserting distinct owners always get distinct customerCodes).
